purpose: Canonical replay observation schema, evidence-tier rules, hard exclusions, exact-slice key, and anti-leakage rules shared by every MLB Replay V1 workstream. Freezes the contract only; does not implement the replay engine, run historical replay, train a model, repair history, or change production behavior.
principles: Settlement is evidence maintenance, not financial authority.
Historical rows are claim-limited by the evidence actually captured.
Exact market slices, not aggregate lanes, are the evaluation unit.
DFS placeholder prices are not sportsbook prices.
Missing/unknown provenance must remain unknown rather than reconstructed from current code.
A replayed decision must never be presented as the original historical decision.
Known historical holes may be excluded explicitly rather than blocking the entire replay program.

identity.notes: Replay-corpus-assigned UUID. Stable for a given (historical_decision_id, replay_code_version, replay_policy_version) tuple.
Canonical original-decision identifier. If the source system never assigned one, this is the resolved stable key; see source_identity.
Raw natural key used to resolve historical_decision_id when no canonical id existed originally. Never used as a feature.
Origin table/system of the historical row.
Null when no shadow bet exists, including within a known missing-shadow incident window.
Canonical market code, e.g. player_strikeouts, moneyline, team_total.
At least one of player_id/team_id required per market type.
Sportsbook or price-source name, including DFS placeholder sources (flagged separately, see hard_exclusions).

decision_time_evidence.notes: Original decision timestamp. Must not be replay-reconstructed; see reconstructed_evidence.
Derived: (game_start_ts_utc - decision_ts_utc) in minutes. Negative values indicate a post-start/live decision.
Derived: model_probability - implied_probability when both present.
Original reason text, verbatim. Never rewritten or backfilled.
Identifies which reasoning/vocabulary version produced original_rationale.
Original policy/config state at decision time.
Original governor allocation state at decision time.

outcome.notes: Required when result is a settled value (win/loss/push/void).
Settlement is evidence maintenance, not financial authority (Principle 4).

replay.notes: When the replay ran. Distinct from decision_ts_utc.
Explicit list of decision-time evidence fields actually available/non-null when replay ran. Operationalizes Principle 5.
Only when the simulation requires stake sizing.
Replay's own generated rationale. Never merged with original_rationale (Principle 9).

integrity_eligibility.notes: Reason codes from the reason_codes registry. Empty array allowed.

TIER_A_FULL_REPLAY.rule: None of the row-level hard-exclusion flags are set, AND decision_time_valid AND sportsbook_price_valid AND result_valid AND model_attributable AND rationale_traceable AND clv_usable are all true.

TIER_B_PERFORMANCE_REPLAY.rule: None of the row-level hard-exclusion flags are set, AND decision_time_valid AND sportsbook_price_valid AND result_valid are all true, BUT at least one of model_attributable, rationale_traceable, clv_usable is false.

TIER_C_FORENSIC_ONLY.rule: Any row-level hard-exclusion flag is set, OR any of decision_time_valid, sportsbook_price_valid, result_valid is false.

row_level.description: DFS placeholder/fallback odds used as if they were a sportsbook price (Principle 7).
decision_ts_utc is at or after game_start_ts_utc for a market whose evidence contract requires a pregame decision.
A decision-time field was back-filled/reconstructed from current code rather than captured live; original decision time cannot be established (Principle 8).
source_identity resolves to more than one candidate historical_decision_id, or cannot be resolved to one at all.
result disagrees across source_table/settlement_route for the same historical_decision_id.
Row falls within a registered known-defect window/category; see known_historical_defects.
odds_american is missing, zero, or outside plausible American-odds bounds, or is otherwise known-invalid.
result is missing or not a valid settled/pending state.

claim_level.description: model_version/model_probability absent. Blocks model-version comparison, calibration, and training claims only. Does NOT exclude the row from Tier B ROI/hit-rate claims.
original_rationale is null/nulled. Blocks rationale-traceability claims only. Does NOT exclude the row from Tier B ROI/hit-rate claims.
closing_price_provenance is unsupported/fake (e.g. entry_fallback). Blocks CLV claims only. Does NOT exclude the row from Tier B non-CLV performance claims.

informational.description: shadow_bet_id is absent (e.g. the July 2026 missing foreign-baseball shadow-row incident). Does not by itself change eligibility tier.

exact_slice_key.notes: model_source_family, line_bucket, price_bucket, and decision_lead_time_bucket are derived at analysis time (see contracts.mlb_replay_v1.exact_slice). Lane-level aggregate statistics must never substitute for this exact-slice key. Additional dimensions may be appended later without removing or reordering these.

structural_rules: No market_snapshot entry with snapshot_ts_utc later than decision_ts_utc may appear in a replay-decision input payload.
No postgame_stats field (any statistic only knowable after game_start_ts_utc, e.g. box score or final score) may appear in a replay-decision input payload.
historical_decision_id may be used only as a join/reporting key after the replay decision is produced, never passed into the scanner, resolver, or governor as a feature.

known_historical_defects.matching_criteria: sport == MLB AND market indicates a foreign-baseball listing AND game_date within window
known_historical_defects.resulting_flags: historical_missing_shadow=true by default for matching rows; known_provenance_damage=true only if decision-time evidence (decision_ts_utc, odds_american) is also unrecoverable for the row.
known_historical_defects.handling_note: Registered as a documented gap, not repaired (Principle 8). Must be excluded from any window-completeness claim. Must not block replay of unaffected MLB rows outside this window/market (Principle 10). Window dates are an initial registration pending confirmation against source data by the owning workstream; do not treat as forensically verified.

known_historical_defects.matching_criteria: model_version is null on an otherwise validly settled row
known_historical_defects.resulting_flags: model_attributable=false -> DOWNGRADE_MISSING_MODEL_ATTRIBUTION -> capped at Tier B, never auto-excluded for this reason alone.

known_historical_defects.matching_criteria: decision_ts_utc provenance is replay-reconstructed, or the original runtime cannot be recovered from the source system
known_historical_defects.description: Historical replay timestamps whose original runtime cannot be recovered.

known_historical_defects.matching_criteria: book/price source indicates DFS placeholder/fallback pricing recorded as if it were a sportsbook price
closing_price_provenance == entry_fallback (the recorded close is a copy of the entry/decision-time price, not a genuine closing snapshot)
known_historical_defects.description: Close provenance problems such as entry_fallback.
known_historical_defects.resulting_flags: clv_usable=false -> DOWNGRADE_UNSUPPORTED_CLOSE_PROVENANCE -> capped at Tier B, not automatically Tier C.

known_historical_defects.matching_criteria: original_rationale is null/empty on a row from a known code path/window that nulled the field
known_historical_defects.resulting_flags: rationale_traceable=false -> DOWNGRADE_MISSING_RATIONALE -> capped at Tier B, not automatically Tier C.
